purpose: Pre-acceptance red-team receipt. This does not create operator acceptance and does not complete the overall baseline; it proves acceptance cannot be used as an exit ramp for weak artifact proof.

operator_acceptance_used_as_exit_ramp.evidence: verify_completion.py requires artifact identity, manifest proof, family receipts, and acceptance-readiness before operator acceptance can be decisive.

stale_local_commit_ref_tree_verifier_or_.evidence: verify_completion.py checks verifier script hash and non-self-referential publication manifest fields rather than trusting stale checked-in tree hashes.

self_referential_completion_lock_tree_ha.evidence: completion-lock.json tree-hash-only proof is insufficient; publication manifest excludes self-referential lock/proof receipts.

acceptance_requested_before_acceptance_r.evidence: This checked-in receipt is required before any acceptance request and records acceptance_requested=false.
